notes.title: New Levels - Update Colorful Colore
notes.content:
Hello, colorful players!

I'm very happy to announce that Colorful Colore is getting an update with 20 completely new levels for a total of 70 levels for you guys to play as well as a 50% discount sale, in case you want to buy this game for any of your friends, speedrun all puzzles with them of just let them break their head into this awesome game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38898300/48953892653514b732aa17ad5c3bd4145de8e82b.png[/img]

Colorful Colore is almost reaching a total of 100 reviews and recently got a release on Nintendo Switch, so I'm very proud of how far this game has come and how much all of you players have enjoyed it.

I'm also optimizing the game a whole bunch more since some players told some levels, especially the huge ones that were getting FPS drops and releasing 2 new achievements about the new levels.

These are all I've to share with you guys, we love Bob and hope you guys love the update and help him there too.

Cheers,

Gagonfe.
